card.name: Sentence-ending periods before a new sentence
card.fires_on: The period (or closing bracket plus period) that ends a sentence in ordinary web prose, right before the next sentence begins with a space.

modes.label: Period ending a sentence
modes.description: A full stop closing a declarative sentence in general web text, where a space and a new sentence follow.

card.plain: It fires on the full stop at the end of a sentence and prepares the model for the space that comes next.
